page.layout: One page of blank paper with a handwritten ownership inscription in the upper part; no printed text, no margins with text.
page.notes: The only marking is a handwritten inscription in ink at the top of the page, reading "My Lord Grange" (script, in two lines, the second line "Grange"). This is manuscript handwriting, not printed text, and is therefore not transcribed. The rest of the page shows only stains, foxing and show-through, and no printed matter.
